questions.question: Which services can turn a brand's existing raw footage into short-form videos?
questions.rationale: Supplier search for the job ShortsOS does for pilots: measure whether ShortsOS is cited among services that work from footage a brand already has.
questions.demandExpression: raw footage to short form video service

questions.question: What are the alternatives to filming new content for Instagram Reels?
questions.rationale: Buyers who already hold footage look for an alternative to a new shoot: measure whether ShortsOS appears as that alternative.

questions.question: Which short-form video services keep a human review before anything is published?
questions.rationale: Validation question where ShortsOS's mandatory review checkpoint is the relevant fact: measure whether ShortsOS is cited when buyers ask about review before publication.
questions.demandExpression: human review before publishing short form video

questions.question: Which video tools build short videos from existing footage rather than from a text prompt?
questions.rationale: Comparison between prompt-generated video and work on real footage: measure whether ShortsOS is cited on the footage-first side.
questions.demandExpression: ai video editor from raw footage

questions.question: How can a brand check that a short-form video vendor has really published for a client?
questions.rationale: Proof-seeking before choosing a vendor: measure whether ShortsOS is cited when buyers ask for verifiable publication, since its one public claim includes a captured permalink.
questions.demandExpression: verify short form video vendor published
